    (hJ : J ∉ cutoffSet D) : cutoffTerm χ V D J s = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : J = 0
  · subst J; exact cutoffTerm_zero χ V D s
  · have hn : 2*D < (J.absNorm : ℝ) := by
      by_contra h
      exact hJ ((mem_cutoffSet hD.le).mpr ⟨hzero, le_of_not_gt h⟩)
    have hv := hV ((J.absNorm : ℝ)/D) ((le_div_iff₀ hD).mpr hn.le)
    simp [cutoffTerm, hv]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.cutoffTerm_hasSum
statement:
theorem cutoffTerm_hasSum (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) (s : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun J : Ideal O => cutoffTerm χ V D J s) (cutoff χ V D s)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero (cutoffTerm_outside χ V hD hV s)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairCoefficient_zero_norm
statement:
theorem pairCoefficient_zero_norm (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ)
    (p : Ideal O × Ideal O) (hp : pairNorm p = 0) : pairCoefficient χ V D p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (p.1*p.2).absNorm = 0 := by unfold pairNorm at hp; exact_mod_cast hp
  have hzero := Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.mp hn
  rw [pairCoefficient, hzero]
  rw [show (⊥ : Ideal O) = 0 from rfl, HeckeFamily.idealCoeff_zero, mul_zero]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairTerm_eq
statement:
theorem pairTerm_eq (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ) (s : ℂ)
    (p : Ideal O × Ideal O) :
    pairCoefficient χ V D p * (pairNorm p : ℂ)^(-s) =
      cutoffTerm χ V D p.1 s * IdealEuler.weighted (idealCoeff χ) s p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutoffTerm_weighted]
  by_cases hp : p.1*p.2 = 0
  · have he : pairNorm p = 0 := by simp [pairNorm, hp]
    rw [pairCoefficient_zero_norm χ V D p he, zero_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, hp, map_zero, mul_zero]
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    simp only [pairCoefficient, pairNorm, Complex.ofReal_natCast,
      IdealEuler.weighted, IdealEuler.normWeight, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
      CubicEisenstein.fullIdealWeight, ite_eq_right hp]
    ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairTerm_summable_norm
statement:
theorem pairTerm_summable_norm (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    Summable (fun p : Ideal O × Ideal O =>
      ‖pairCoefficient χ V D p * (pairNorm p : ℂ)^(-s)‖)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pairTerm_eq] using
    (cutoffTerm_hasSum χ V hD hV s).summable.norm.mul_norm
      (IdealEuler.weighted_summable_norm _ (idealCoeff_norm_le_one χ) s hs)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairSeries_eq
statement:
theorem pairSeries_eq (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) (s : ℂ) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    (∑' p : Ideal O × Ideal O, pairCoefficient χ V D p * (pairNorm p : ℂ)^(-s)) =
      cutoff χ V D s * LFunction χ s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pairTerm_eq]
  rw [← tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm (cutoffTerm_hasSum χ V hD hV s).summable.norm
    (IdealEuler.weighted_summable_norm _ (idealCoeff_norm_le_one χ) s hs)]
  rw [(cutoffTerm_hasSum χ V hD hV s).tsum_eq, LFunction_eq_series χ hs]
  rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairMajorant_summable
statement:
theorem pairMajorant_summable (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    Summable (fun p : Ideal O × Ideal O =>
      ‖pairCoefficient χ V D p‖*(pairNorm p)^(-(ρ.re+2)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := pairTerm_summable_norm χ V hD hV (ρ+2) (by norm_num; linarith)
  apply h.congr
  intro p
  by_cases hp : pairNorm p = 0
  · simp [pairCoefficient_zero_norm χ V D p hp]
  · have hn : 0 < pairNorm p := lt_of_le_of_ne (by unfold pairNorm; positivity) (Ne.symm hp)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos hn]
    simp only [neg_re, add_re]
    norm_num

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairGamma_tsum
statement:
theorem pairGamma_tsum (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re)
    (Y t : ℝ) :
    (∑' p : Ideal O × Ideal O, gammaTerm (pairCoefficient χ V D p) (pairNorm p) ρ Y t) =
      detectorIntegrand χ V D Y ρ (line t)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 1 < (ρ+line t).re := by simp only [add_re, line_re]; linarith
  calc
    _ = (Y : ℂ)^(line t)*Gamma (line t)*
        (∑' p : Ideal O × Ideal O, pairCoefficient χ V D p*(pairNorm p : ℂ)^(-(ρ+line t))) := by
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]
      apply tsum_congr
      intro p
      unfold gammaTerm
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [pairSeries_eq χ V hD hV _ hs]; unfold detectorIntegrand; ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.detector_hasSum_pairs
statement:
theorem detector_hasSum_pairs (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    HasSum (pairExponential χ V D ρ Y) (detectorIntegral χ V D Y ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gamma_expansion (pairCoefficient χ V D) pairNorm
    (fun p => by unfold pairNorm; positivity) (pairCoefficient_zero_norm χ V D)
    ρ hY (pairMajorant_summable χ V hD hV hρ)
  unfold pairExponential detectorIntegral
  simpa only [pairGamma_tsum χ V hD hV hρ, line] using h

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.detector_eq_double_sum
statement:
theorem detector_eq_double_sum (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    detectorIntegral χ V D Y ρ = ∑' J : Ideal O, ∑' K : Ideal O,
      (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius J : ℂ) * V ((J.absNorm : ℝ)/D) *
      idealCoeff χ (J*K) * (((J*K).absNorm : ℝ) : ℂ)^(-ρ) *
        Complex.exp (-(((J*K).absNorm : ℝ) : ℂ)/(Y : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := detector_hasSum_pairs χ V hD hY hV hρ
  rw [← h.tsum_eq, h.summable.tsum_prod]
  rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairExponential_zero_left
statement:
theorem pairExponential_zero_left (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ)
    (ρ : ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (K : Ideal O) : pairExponential χ V D ρ Y (0,K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairExponential
  rw [pairCoefficient_zero_norm χ V D _ (by simp [pairNorm]), zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairExponential_zero_right
statement:
theorem pairExponential_zero_right (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ)
    (ρ : ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (J : Ideal O) : pairExponential χ V D ρ Y (J,0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairExponential
  rw [pairCoefficient_zero_norm χ V D _ (by simp [pairNorm]), zero_mul, zero_mul]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairExponential_fiber
statement:
theorem pairExponential_fiber (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ)
    (ρ : ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (J : Ideal O) :
    (∑' p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J, pairExponential χ V D ρ Y p.val) =
      HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.exponentialTerm χ V D ρ Y J
proof:
:= by
  have he (p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J) :
      pairExponential χ V D ρ Y p.val =
        ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.moebius p.val.1 : ℂ)*V ((p.val.1.absNorm : ℝ)/D)*
          IdealEuler.weighted (idealCoeff χ) ρ (p.val.1*p.val.2))*
          Complex.exp (-((J.absNorm : ℝ) : ℂ)/(Y : ℂ)) := by
    rw [pairExponential, pairTerm_eq, cutoffTerm_weighted, mul_assoc _ _
      (IdealEuler.weighted (idealCoeff χ) ρ p.val.2), ← map_mul]
    congr 2
    rw [pairNorm, p.property]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [tsum_mul_right, HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.weighted_fiber]
  rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.detector_hasSum_convolution
statement:
theorem detector_hasSum_convolution (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    HasSum (HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.exponentialTerm χ V D ρ Y)
      (detectorIntegral χ V D Y ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (detector_hasSum_pairs χ V hD hY hV hρ).tsum_fiberwise
    (fun p : Ideal O × Ideal O => p.1*p.2)
  change HasSum (fun J : Ideal O => ∑' p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J,
    pairExponential χ V D ρ Y p.val) _ at h
  simpa only [pairExponential_fiber] using h

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.detector_large_product_tail
statement:
theorem detector_large_product_tail (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 2 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → V x = 1)
    (hVzero : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    (∑' J : Ideal O, HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.exponentialTerm χ V D ρ Y J *
      (1-V (2*(J.absNorm : ℝ)/D))) =
      detectorIntegral χ V D Y ρ - Complex.exp (-1/(Y : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := detector_hasSum_convolution χ V (by linarith : 0 < D) hY hVzero hρ
  rw [HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.exponential_sum_tail χ V D hD hV hVzero ρ Y h.summable,
    h.tsum_eq]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairExponential_summable_norm
statement:
theorem pairExponential_summable_norm (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    Summable (fun p : Ideal O × Ideal O => ‖pairExponential χ V D ρ Y p‖)
proof:
:=
  (detector_hasSum_pairs χ V hD hY hV hρ).summable.norm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairTail_summable
statement:
theorem pairTail_summable (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 0 < D) (hY : 0 < Y) (hVzero : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖V x‖ ≤ 1) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    Summable (pairTail χ V D ρ Y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm
  apply ((pairExponential_summable_norm χ V hD hY hVzero hρ).mul_right 2).of_nonneg_of_le
    (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
  intro p
  rw [pairTail, norm_mul]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
  have hn := norm_sub_le (1 : ℂ) (V (2*pairNorm p/D))
  rw [norm_one] at hn
  linarith [hV (2*pairNorm p/D)]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.pairTail_fiber
statement:
theorem pairTail_fiber (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) (D : ℝ)
    (ρ : ℂ) (Y : ℝ) (J : Ideal O) :
    (∑' p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J, pairTail χ V D ρ Y p.val) =
      HeckeDetectorWitnessArithmetic.exponentialTerm χ V D ρ Y J *
        (1-V (2*(J.absNorm : ℝ)/D))
proof:
:= by
  have hn (p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J) : pairNorm p.val = (J.absNorm : ℝ) := by
    rw [pairNorm, p.property]
  simp_rw [pairTail, hn]
  rw [tsum_mul_right, pairExponential_fiber]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.GammaDetectorExpansion.detector_eq_pair_tail
statement:
theorem detector_eq_pair_tail (χ : Character) (V : ℝ → ℂ) {D Y : ℝ}
    (hD : 2 ≤ D) (hY : 0 < Y)
    (hVone : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → V x = 1)
    (hVzero : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → V x = 0)
    (hV : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖V x‖ ≤ 1) {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : -1 < ρ.re) :
    HasSum (pairTail χ V D ρ Y)
      (detectorIntegral χ V D Y ρ - Complex.exp (-1/(Y : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := pairTail_summable χ V (by linarith : 0 < D) hY hVzero hV hρ
  have hf := hs.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise (fun p : Ideal O × Ideal O => p.1*p.2)
  change HasSum (fun J : Ideal O => ∑' p : CompletedGauss.MulFiber J,
    pairTail χ V D ρ Y p.val) _ at hf
  simp_rw [pairTail_fiber] at hf
  have he := hf.tsum_eq
  rw [detector_large_product_tail χ V hD hY hVone hVzero hρ] at he
  exact he.symm ▸ hs.hasSum

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.principalConstant_pos
statement:
theorem principalConstant_pos (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M] :
    0<principalConstant M
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : 0<(M.absNorm : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr (NeZero.ne M))
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by linarith [HeckeLogarithmicInput.uniformConstant_nonneg])
    (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hQ _)) (pow_pos (HeckeDeletionBounds.localBound_pos (by norm_num)) _)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.poleRemoved_eq_mul_regular
statement:
lemma poleRemoved_eq_mul_regular (χ : Character) (hχ : χ.residue=1)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : s+1≠0) :
    HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved χ s=(s+1)*HeckeLogarithmicInput.regular χ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HeckeLogarithmicInput.regular,ite_eq_left hχ,HeckePrincipalStrip.sourceNormalized]
  field_simp

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.principal_poleRemoved_growth
statement:
theorem principal_poleRemoved_growth (χ : Character) (hχ : χ.residue=1)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : (19/20 : ℝ)≤s.re) :
    ‖HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved χ s‖≤principalConstant χ.modulus*‖s+1‖*(3+|s.im|)^2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ,_,hp,hQ,hmask⟩ := exists_primitive_character χ
  have hψ : ψ.residue=1 := (HeckeFiniteDeletion.principal_iff_of_mask χ ψ hmask).mp hχ
  have hs0 : 0<s.re := by linarith
  have h0 : s≠0 := by intro hh; norm_num [hh] at hs
  have hplus : s+1≠0 := by
    intro hh
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re hh
    simp only [add_re,one_re,zero_re] at hr
    linarith
  have heq : HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved χ s=
      ((s+1)*HeckeLogarithmicInput.regular ψ s)*HeckeFiniteDeletion.factors χ.modulus ψ s := by
    rw [← poleRemoved_eq_mul_regular ψ hψ hplus]
    by_cases h1 : s=1
    · subst s
      rw [HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved_one,HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved_one]
      exact HeckeFiniteDeletion.regularizedL_eq_of_mask χ ψ hmask (by norm_num)
    · rw [HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved_eq χ h0 h1,HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved_eq ψ h0 h1,
        HeckeFiniteDeletion.LFunction_eq_of_mask χ ψ hmask hs0 h1]
      ring
  have hg := HeckeLogarithmicInput.regular_right_growth ψ hp (by linarith : -(1/10 : ℝ)≤s.re)
  have hd := (HeckeDeletionBounds.factors_bound_pow (19/20) (by norm_num)
    χ.modulus ψ hs).1
  have hQ' : (ψ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)^(3/5 : ℝ)≤(χ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)^(3/5 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hQ) (by norm_num)
  have hC := HeckeLogarithmicInput.uniformConstant_nonneg
  have hD := (HeckeDeletionBounds.localBound_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<19/20)).le
  rw [heq,norm_mul,norm_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖s+1‖*(HeckeLogarithmicInput.uniformConstant*(ψ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)^(3/5 : ℝ)*
          (3+|s.im|)^2))*
        HeckeDeletionBounds.localBound (19/20)^(IdealMobiusDivisorSum.primeSupport χ.modulus).card := by
      gcongr
    _ ≤ (‖s+1‖*((1+HeckeLogarithmicInput.uniformConstant)*(χ.modulus.absNorm : ℝ)^(3/5 : ℝ)*
          (3+|s.im|)^2))*
        HeckeDeletionBounds.localBound (19/20)^(IdealMobiusDivisorSum.primeSupport χ.modulus).card := by
      gcongr
      linarith
    _ = _ := by unfold principalConstant; ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.wAmplitude_pos
statement:
theorem wAmplitude_pos (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M] {cw : ℝ} (hcw : 1<cw) :
    0<wAmplitude M cw
proof:
:= by
  unfold wAmplitude
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith)) (principalConstant_pos M)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.zAmplitude_pos
statement: theorem zAmplitude_pos (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M] : 0<zAmplitude M
proof:
:= by
  unfold zAmplitude
  exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (principalConstant_pos M)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.fixed_principal_w_growth
statement:
theorem fixed_principal_w_growth (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M]
    {cw : ℝ} (hcw : 1<cw) {x : ℝ} (hx : x∈Icc (19/20 : ℝ) cw) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved (fixedPrincipal M) ((x:ℂ)+t*I)‖≤wAmplitude M cw*height t^3
proof:
:= by
  have hb := principal_poleRemoved_growth (fixedPrincipal M) rfl
    (show (19/20 : ℝ)≤(((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).re by simpa using hx.1)
  have hn : ‖((x:ℂ)+t*I)+1‖≤(cw+2)*height t := by
    apply (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans
    simp only [add_re,add_im,ofReal_re,ofReal_im,mul_re,mul_im,I_re,I_im,
      mul_zero,sub_zero,add_zero,zero_add,mul_one,one_re,one_im]
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [hx.1] : 0<x+1)]
    unfold height
    have hmul : 0≤(cw+1)*|t| := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (abs_nonneg t)
    nlinarith [hx.2]
  have hheight : (3+|t|)^2≤9*height t^2 := by
    have hh : 3+|t|≤3*height t := by unfold height; linarith [abs_nonneg t]
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0≤3+|t|) hh 2
    simpa only [mul_pow,show (3:ℝ)^2=9 by norm_num] using hp
  have hC := (principalConstant_pos M).le
  have ht0 := (height_pos t).le
  change ‖HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved (fixedPrincipal M) ((x:ℂ)+t*I)‖≤
    principalConstant M*‖((x:ℂ)+t*I)+1‖*(3+|(((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).im|)^2 at hb
  simp only [add_im,ofReal_im,mul_im,ofReal_re,I_im,I_re,mul_one,mul_zero,add_zero,zero_add] at hb
  calc
    _ ≤ principalConstant M*‖((x:ℂ)+t*I)+1‖*(3+|t|)^2 := hb
    _ ≤ principalConstant M*((cw+2)*height t)*(9*height t^2) := by
      have hc2 : 0≤cw+2 := by linarith
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by unfold wAmplitude; ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.fixed_principal_z_growth
statement:
theorem fixed_principal_z_growth (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M]
    {e : ℝ} (he : 0<e) (he' : e≤2/3) {x : ℝ}
    (hx : x∈Icc (33/200 : ℝ) (1/6+e)) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved (fixedPrincipal M) (6*((x:ℂ)+t*I))‖≤zAmplitude M*height t^3
proof:
:= by
  have hre : (6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).re=6*x := by simp
  have him : (6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).im=6*t := by simp
  have habs : |(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).im|=6*|t| := by rw [him,abs_mul]; norm_num
  have hb := principal_poleRemoved_growth (fixedPrincipal M) rfl
    (show (19/20 : ℝ)≤(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).re by rw [hre]; linarith [hx.1])
  have hn : ‖(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ)+1‖≤6*height t := by
    apply (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _).trans
    simp only [add_re,add_im,one_re,one_im,add_zero,hre,him]
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [hx.1] : 0<6*x+1),abs_mul]
    rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<6)]
    unfold height
    linarith [hx.2]
  have hheight : (3+6*|t|)^2≤36*height t^2 := by
    have hh : 3+6*|t|≤6*height t := by unfold height; linarith
    have hp := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0≤3+6*|t|) hh 2
    simpa only [mul_pow,show (6:ℝ)^2=36 by norm_num] using hp
  have hC := (principalConstant_pos M).le
  have ht0 := (height_pos t).le
  change ‖HeckeOrigin.poleRemoved (fixedPrincipal M) (6*((x:ℂ)+t*I))‖≤
    principalConstant M*‖(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ)+1‖*(3+|(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ).im|)^2 at hb
  rw [habs] at hb
  calc
    _ ≤ principalConstant M*‖(6*((x:ℂ)+t*I) : ℂ)+1‖*(3+6*|t|)^2 := hb
    _ ≤ principalConstant M*(6*height t)*(36*height t^2) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by unfold zAmplitude; ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.source_w_boundary
statement:
theorem source_w_boundary (W0 W1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) (a1 b1 : ℝ)
    (ha1 : 0<a1) (hW1 : Function.support W1⊆Icc a1 b1)
    (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M] (X Y Z : ℝ) (hY : 0<Y)
    (eta : Character) (s z : ℂ) (hEta : LFunction eta s≠0) (H B : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) {cw AH : ℝ}
    (hcw : 1<cw) (hAH : 0≤AH) (JH : ℕ)
    (hHB : ContinuousOn (fun w => H w z*B w z) {w : ℂ | (19/20:ℝ)≤w.re ∧ w.re≤cw})
    (hHBbd : ∀x∈Icc (19/20:ℝ) cw, ∀t : ℝ, (x=19/20 ∨ x=cw ∨ 1≤|t|) →
      ‖H ((x:ℂ)+t*I) z * B ((x:ℂ)+t*I) z‖≤AH*height t^JH) :
    BoundaryControl (fun w => sourceMultiplier W0 W1 X Y Z eta s H B w z *
      LFunction (fixedPrincipal M) w) (19/20) cw
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbeMellinBoundary.source_w_boundary W0 W1 a1 b1 ha1 hW1 M X Y Z hY eta s z hEta H B
    (AL:=wAmplitude M cw) hcw hAH (wAmplitude_pos M hcw).le JH 3 hHB hHBbd
  intro x hx t _
  exact fixed_principal_w_growth M hcw hx t

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PrincipalMellinGrowth.source_z_boundary
statement:
theorem source_z_boundary (W0 W1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ) (a0 b0 : ℝ)
    (ha0 : 0<a0) (hW0 : Function.support W0⊆Icc a0 b0)
    (M : Ideal HeckeFamily.O) [NeZero M] (X Y Z : ℝ) (hX : 0<X) (hZ : 0<Z)
    (eta : Character) (s : ℂ) (hEta : LFunction eta s≠0) (H B : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ) {e AH : ℝ}
    (he : 0<e) (he' : e≤2/3) (hAH : 0≤AH) (JH : ℕ)
    (hHB : ContinuousOn (fun z => H 1 z*B 1 z)
      {z : ℂ | (33/200:ℝ)≤z.re ∧ z.re≤1/6+e})
    (hHBbd : ∀x∈Icc (33/200:ℝ) (1/6+e), ∀t : ℝ, (x=33/200 ∨ x=1/6+e ∨ 1≤|t|) →
      ‖H 1 ((x:ℂ)+t*I) * B 1 ((x:ℂ)+t*I)‖≤AH*height t^JH) :
    BoundaryControl (fun z => sourceMultiplier W0 W1 X Y Z eta s H B 1 z *
      LFunction (fixedPrincipal M) (6*z)) (33/200) (1/6+e)
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbeMellinBoundary.source_z_boundary W0 W1 a0 b0 ha0 hW0 M X Y Z hX hZ eta s hEta H B
    (AL:=zAmplitude M) he hAH (zAmplitude_pos M).le JH 3 hHB hHBbd
  intro x hx t _
  exact fixed_principal_z_growth M he he' hx t

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.continuationMargin_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact lt_min (sub_pos.mpr hω) hσ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.continuationMargin_le_gap
statement:
theorem continuationMargin_le_gap (β ω σ : ℝ) :
    continuationMargin β ω σ ≤ β - 7 / 8 - ω
proof:
:=
  min_le_left _ _

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.continuationMargin_le_sigma
statement:
theorem continuationMargin_le_sigma (β ω σ : ℝ) :
    continuationMargin β ω σ ≤ σ
proof:
:=
  min_le_right _ _

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.continuation_boundary_gt
statement:
theorem continuation_boundary_gt {β ω σ : ℝ} (hω : 0 < ω) :
    7 / 8 < β - continuationMargin β ω σ
proof:
:= by
  have h := continuationMargin_le_gap β ω σ
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.max_signal_exponents
statement:
theorem max_signal_exponents (β ω σ c : ℝ) :
    max (7 / 8 + c + ω) (β + c - σ) =
      β + c - continuationMargin β ω σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold continuationMargin
  rcases le_total (β - 7 / 8 - ω) σ with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    linarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_right (by linarith)]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.max_normalized_signal_exponents
statement:
theorem max_normalized_signal_exponents (β ω σ : ℝ) :
    max (3 / 16 + ω) (β - 11 / 16 - σ) =
      β - 11 / 16 - continuationMargin β ω σ
proof:
:= by
  have h : (7 / 8 : ℝ) + -(11 / 16) = 3 / 16 := by norm_num
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, h] using max_signal_exponents β ω σ (-(11 / 16))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.exists_gt_supremum_sub
statement:
theorem exists_gt_supremum_sub {S : Set ℝ} (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hbounded : BddAbove S) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, sSup S - ε < x
proof:
:= by
  apply (lt_csSup_iff hbounded hne).mp
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.uniform_bound_below_supremum_false
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hlt⟩ := exists_gt_supremum_sub hne hbounded hε
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound x hx)) hlt

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.exists_gt_supremum_sub_of_insert
statement:
theorem exists_gt_supremum_sub_of_insert {S : Set ℝ} {a ε : ℝ}
    (hbounded : BddAbove (insert a S)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (ha : a ≤ sSup (insert a S) - ε) :
    ∃ x ∈ S, sSup (insert a S) - ε < x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hlt⟩ :=
    exists_gt_supremum_sub (Set.insert_nonempty a S) hbounded hε
  rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hx with hxa | hxS
  · subst x
    exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge ha) hlt)
  · exact ⟨x, hxS, hlt⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.seven_eighths_of_uniform_margin
statement:
theorem seven_eighths_of_uniform_margin {S : Set ℝ}
    (hne : S.Nonempty) (hbounded : BddAbove S)
    (hbound : 7 / 8 < sSup S →
      ∃ ω σ : ℝ, ω < sSup S - 7 / 8 ∧ 0 < σ ∧
        ∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ sSup S - continuationMargin (sSup S) ω σ) :
    sSup S ≤ 7 / 8
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨ω, σ, hω, hσ, hbound⟩ := hbound (lt_of_not_ge h)
  exact uniform_bound_below_supremum_false hne hbounded
    (continuationMargin_pos hω hσ) hbound

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Supremum.seven_eighths_of_uniform_margin_with_sentinel
statement:
theorem seven_eighths_of_uniform_margin_with_sentinel {S : Set ℝ}
    (hbounded : BddAbove (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S))
    (hbound : 7 / 8 < sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) →
      ∃ ω σ : ℝ, 0 < ω ∧ ω < sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) - 7 / 8 ∧
        0 < σ ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, x ≤ sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) -
          continuationMargin (sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S)) ω σ) :
    sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) ≤ 7 / 8
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨ω, σ, hω0, hω, hσ, hbound⟩ := hbound (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hε := continuationMargin_pos hω hσ
  have hboundary := continuation_boundary_gt (β := sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S))
    (σ := σ) hω0
  have hsentinel : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S) -
      continuationMargin (sSup (insert (1 / 2 : ℝ) S)) ω σ := by
    linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hlt⟩ := exists_gt_supremum_sub_of_insert hbounded hε hsentinel
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound x hx)) hlt

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.section_deriv_smooth
statement:
theorem section_deriv_smooth (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E × ℝ => deriv (F p.1) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hFp : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (Function.uncurry (fun p : E × ℝ => F p.1)) :=
    hF.comp (contDiff_fst.fst.prodMk contDiff_snd)
  have hd := hFp.fderiv contDiff_snd (by simp : (∞ : ℕ∞ω) + 1 ≤ ∞)
  simpa only [deriv] using hd.clm_apply (contDiff_const (c := (1 : ℝ)))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.section_iteratedDeriv_smooth
statement:
theorem section_iteratedDeriv_smooth (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (j : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E × ℝ => iteratedDeriv j (F p.1) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Function.uncurry_def] using hF
  | succ j ih =>
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ] using
      section_deriv_smooth (fun σ => iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) ih

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.tsupport_iteratedDeriv_subset
statement:
theorem tsupport_iteratedDeriv_subset (f : ℝ → ℂ) (j : ℕ) :
    tsupport (iteratedDeriv j f) ⊆ tsupport f
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    exact tsupport_deriv_subset.trans ih

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.compact_family_deriv_integrable
statement:
theorem compact_family_deriv_integrable (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (K : Set ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hsupp : ∀ σ, Function.support (F σ) ⊆ K) (σ : E) (j : ℕ) :
    Integrable (iteratedDeriv j (F σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F σ) := hF.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hc : HasCompactSupport (iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact hK
    exact (subset_tsupport _).trans ((tsupport_iteratedDeriv_subset (F σ) j).trans
      (closure_minimal (hsupp σ) hK.isClosed))
  exact (hs.continuous_iteratedDeriv j (by simp)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hc

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.compact_family_deriv_L1_bound
statement:
theorem compact_family_deriv_L1_bound (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (K : Set ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hsupp : ∀ σ, Function.support (F σ) ⊆ K) (J : Set E) (hJ : IsCompact J)
    (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ σ ∈ J, (∫ u : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv j (F σ) u‖) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  have hc := (section_iteratedDeriv_smooth F hF j).continuous.norm
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (hJ.prod hK).bddAbove_image hc.continuousOn
  let C : ℝ := (|M| + 1) * (volume.real K + 1)
  refine ⟨C, by dsimp [C]; positivity, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  have hbound : ∀ u ∈ K, ‖iteratedDeriv j (F σ) u‖ ≤ |M| + 1 := by
    intro u hu
    exact (hM (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (show (σ, u) ∈ J ×ˢ K from ⟨hσ, hu⟩))).trans (by linarith [le_abs_self M])
  have hs : Function.support (iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) ⊆ K :=
    (subset_tsupport _).trans ((tsupport_iteratedDeriv_subset (F σ) j).trans
      (closure_minimal (hsupp σ) hK.isClosed))
  have hzero : ∀ u, u ∉ K → ‖iteratedDeriv j (F σ) u‖ = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    have hz : iteratedDeriv j (F σ) u = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hu (hs hn)
    simp [hz]
  have hi := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const («μ» := volume) (f := fun u => ‖iteratedDeriv j (F σ) u‖)
    hK.measure_lt_top (C := |M| + 1) (fun u hu => by simpa using hbound u hu)
  rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero] at hi
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg (fun u => norm_nonneg _))] at hi
  exact hi.trans (by dsimp [C]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg M])

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.compact_family_fourier_power_bound
statement:
theorem compact_family_fourier_power_bound (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (K : Set ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hsupp : ∀ σ, Function.support (F σ) ⊆ K) (J : Set E) (hJ : IsCompact J)
    (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ σ ∈ J, ∀ w : ℝ,
      |w| ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hb⟩ := compact_family_deriv_L1_bound F hF K hK hsupp J hJ j
  refine ⟨C / (2 * Real.pi) ^ j, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ w
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F σ) := hF.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hfour := Real.fourier_iteratedDeriv (N := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs
    (fun k _ => compact_family_deriv_integrable F hF K hK hsupp σ k)
    (by simp : (j : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  have hid : (2 * Real.pi) ^ j * (|w| ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖) =
      ‖𝓕 (iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) w‖ := by
    rw [hfour]
    simp only [norm_smul, norm_pow, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hn : ‖𝓕 (iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) w‖ ≤ C := by
    apply (VectorFourier.norm_fourierIntegral_le_integral_norm
      Real.fourierChar volume (innerₗ ℝ) (iteratedDeriv j (F σ)) w).trans
    exact hb σ hσ
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < (2 * Real.pi) ^ j)).mpr
  rw [← hid] at hn
  calc
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) ^ j * (|w| ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖) := mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ C := hn

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CompactProfileFamily.compact_family_fourier_weighted_bound
statement:
theorem compact_family_fourier_weighted_bound (F : E → ℝ → ℂ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry F)) (K : Set ℝ) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hsupp : ∀ σ, Function.support (F σ) ⊆ K) (J : Set E) (hJ : IsCompact J)
    (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ σ ∈ J, ∀ w : ℝ,
      (1 + |w|) ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, h0⟩ := compact_family_fourier_power_bound F hF K hK hsupp J hJ 0
  obtain ⟨Cj, hCj, hj⟩ := compact_family_fourier_power_bound F hF K hK hsupp J hJ j
  refine ⟨2 ^ j * (C₀ + Cj), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ w
  have hbase : ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖ ≤ C₀ := by simpa using h0 σ hσ w
  by_cases hw : |w| ≤ 1
  · calc
      _ ≤ 2 ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) j) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ 2 ^ j * C₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
  · have hw' : 1 ≤ |w| := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hw)
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * |w|) ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) j) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = 2 ^ j * (|w| ^ j * ‖𝓕 (F σ) w‖) := by rw [mul_pow, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ 2 ^ j * Cj := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hj σ hσ w) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.rectangularPair_f_continuous
statement:
theorem rectangularPair_f_continuous (a b : UnitAddCircle) (u v : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 < u) (hv : 0 < v) :
    ContinuousOn (rectangularPair a b u v hu hv).f (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  (scaledEvenPair_f_continuous a u hu).mul (scaledEvenPair_f_continuous b v hv)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.pair_f_continuous
statement:
theorem pair_f_continuous {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn (pair w).f (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ContinuousOn (fun t => ∑ p : (Fin N × Fin N) × Fin 2,
      w p.1 * (parityPair p.1.1 p.1.2 N (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (NeZero.pos N)) p.2).f t)
      (Ioi 0) := by
    apply continuousOn_finsetSum
    intro p _
    exact continuousOn_const.mul
      (rectangularPair_f_continuous (xShift p.1.1 p.1.2 N p.2)
        (yShift p.1.2 N p.2) _ _ _ _)
  apply h.congr
  intro t _
  simp only [pair, finitePair, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.theta_continuous
statement:
theorem theta_continuous {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ) :
    ContinuousOn (theta w) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  (pair_f_continuous w).congr (fun _t ht => theta_eq_pair w ht)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.theta_locallyIntegrable
statement:
theorem theta_locallyIntegrable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ) :
    LocallyIntegrableOn (theta w) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  (theta_continuous w).locallyIntegrableOn measurableSet_Ioi

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.theta_rapid
statement:
theorem theta_rapid {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    (fun t => theta w t - w (0,0)) =O[atTop] (fun t : ℝ => t ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((pair w).hf_top r).congr' _ Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with t ht
  rw [theta_eq_pair w ht, pair_f₀]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.scaledTheta_continuous
statement:
theorem scaledTheta_continuous {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ)
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => theta w (A * t)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  (theta_continuous w).comp (by fun_prop) (fun t ht => mul_pos hA ht)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.PeriodicThetaRegularity.scaledTheta_rapid
statement:
theorem scaledTheta_rapid {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (w : Fin N × Fin N → ℂ)
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (r : ℝ) :
    (fun t => theta w (A * t) - w (0,0)) =O[atTop] (fun t : ℝ => t ^ r)
proof:
:=
  rapid_rescale (theta w) (w (0,0)) (theta_rapid w) hA r

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayPrimeNormalizer.asymptotic
statement:
theorem asymptotic (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (W : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hc : HasCompactSupport W) (hp : tsupport W ⊆ Set.Ioi 0) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.log x / x ^ (1/6 : ℝ) * normalizer M H S W x)
      atTop (𝓝 ((RayQuotient.classNumber M H : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, W y * y ^ (-5/6 : ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  PNT.AnnularPrimeMass.weightedPrimeSumDeleted_tendsto _ S
    (HeckeRayPrimes.quotientClassCoeff_ratio_tendsto M H hH) W hW hc hp

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayPrimeNormalizer.eventually_lower_bound
statement:
theorem eventually_lower_bound (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (W : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hc : HasCompactSupport W) (hp : tsupport W ⊆ Set.Ioi 0)
    (hW0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ W y) (hWne : W ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      c * x ^ (1/6 : ℝ) / Real.log x ≤ normalizer M H S W x
proof:
:= by
  apply PNT.AnnularPrimeMass.weightedPrimeSumDeleted_eventually_lower_bound _ S
    (show 0 < (RayQuotient.classNumber M H : ℝ)⁻¹ from inv_pos.mpr (by
      exact_mod_cast RayQuotient.classNumber_pos M H))
    (HeckeRayPrimes.quotientClassCoeff_ratio_tendsto M H hH) W hW hc hp hW0 hWne

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayPrimeNormalizer.eventually_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_pos (S : Finset (Ideal O)) (W : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W) (hc : HasCompactSupport W) (hp : tsupport W ⊆ Set.Ioi 0)
    (hW0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ W y) (hWne : W ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 0 < normalizer M H S W x
proof:
:= by
  apply PNT.AnnularPrimeMass.weightedPrimeSumDeleted_eventually_pos _ S
    (show 0 < (RayQuotient.classNumber M H : ℝ)⁻¹ from inv_pos.mpr (by
      exact_mod_cast RayQuotient.classNumber_pos M H))
    (HeckeRayPrimes.quotientClassCoeff_ratio_tendsto M H hH) W hW hc hp hW0 hWne

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.step_sub
statement:
theorem step_sub (x : ℝ) (hx : (4 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ x) :
    step x - 4 / 3 = 2 * (x - 4 / 3) / (3 * x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 3 * x - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
  apply (eq_div_iff hd).mpr
  unfold step
  rw [sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd]
  ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.step_gt
statement:
theorem step_gt {x : ℝ} (hx : (4 / 3 : ℝ) < x) :
    (4 / 3 : ℝ) < step x
proof:
:= by
  have h := step_sub x hx.le
  have hp : 0 < 2 * (x - 4 / 3) / (3 * x - 1) :=
    div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (sub_pos.mpr hx)) (by linarith)
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.step_error_le
statement:
theorem step_error_le {x : ℝ} (hx : (4 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ x) :
    step x - 4 / 3 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (x - 4 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_sub x hx]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 3 * x - 1)).mpr
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 4 / 3)]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.step_lt
statement: theorem step_lt {x : ℝ} (hx : (4 / 3 : ℝ) < x) : step x < x
proof:
:= by
  have h := step_error_le hx.le
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.exponent_bounds
statement:
theorem exponent_bounds (n : ℕ) :
    (4 / 3 : ℝ) < exponent n ∧ exponent n ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [exponent]
  | succ n ih =>
    exact ⟨step_gt ih.1, (step_lt ih.1).le.trans ih.2⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.exponent_error_le
statement:
theorem exponent_error_le (n : ℕ) :
    exponent n - 4 / 3 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [exponent]
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      exponent (n + 1) - 4 / 3 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (exponent n - 4 / 3) :=
        step_error_le (exponent_bounds n).1.le
      _ ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by norm_num)
      _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + 1) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.exists_exponent_lt
statement:
theorem exists_exponent_lt {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, exponent n < 4 / 3 + ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hε (by norm_num : (2 / 3 : ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have hp : (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ^ n := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) _) (by norm_num)
  have he := exponent_error_le n
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.HeathBrownIteration.finite_improvement
statement:
theorem finite_improvement {P : ℝ → Prop} (hstart : P 2)
    (himprove : ∀ x : ℝ, (4 / 3 : ℝ) < x → x ≤ 2 → P x → P (step x))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, (4 / 3 : ℝ) < x ∧ x ≤ 2 ∧ x < 4 / 3 + ε ∧ P x
proof:
:= by
  have hp (n : ℕ) : P (exponent n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hstart
    | succ n ih => exact himprove _ (exponent_bounds n).1 (exponent_bounds n).2 ih
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_exponent_lt hε
  exact ⟨exponent n, (exponent_bounds n).1, (exponent_bounds n).2, hn, hp n⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.mem_characters_iff
statement:
theorem mem_characters_iff (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (χ : MulChar R ℂ) :
    χ ∈ characters H ↔ ∀ u ∈ H, χ u = 1
proof:
:=
  MulChar.mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_iff

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.card_characters
statement:
theorem card_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) :
    Fintype.card (characters H) = Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact MulChar.card_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.exists_character_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_character_ne_one (H : Subgroup Rˣ) {u : Rˣ} (hu : u ∉ H) :
    ∃ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) u ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  apply hu
  have hall : ∀ χ ∈ characters H, χ u = 1 := by
    intro χ hχ
    by_contra h
    exact hn ⟨⟨χ, hχ⟩, h⟩
  have hh := (MulChar.mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_symm_iff).mpr hall
  simpa only [characters, OrderDual.toDual_ofDual, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply] using hh

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_characters_unit
statement:
theorem sum_characters_unit (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (u : Rˣ) :
    ∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) u =
      if u ∈ H then (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ H
  · simp only [hu, ite_true]
    calc
      _ = ∑ _χ : characters H, (1 : ℂ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro χ _
        exact (mem_characters_iff H χ).mp χ.property u hu
      _ = _ := by simp [card_characters]
  · simp only [hu, ite_false]
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_character_ne_one H hu
    refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hχ ?_
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← MulChar.mul_apply]
    exact Fintype.sum_bijective _ (Group.mulLeft_bijective χ) _ _ fun χ' ↦ rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_characters
statement:
theorem sum_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (r : R) :
    ∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) r =
      if inUnitSubgroup H r then (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : IsUnit r
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hi : inUnitSubgroup H (u : R) ↔ u ∈ H := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨v, hv, h⟩
        exact (Units.ext hv) ▸ h
      · exact fun h ↦ ⟨u, rfl, h⟩
    rw [sum_characters_unit, hi]
  · have hn : ¬ inUnitSubgroup H r := by
      rintro ⟨u, rfl, _⟩
      exact hr u.isUnit
    simp only [hn, ite_false]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun χ _ ↦ MulChar.map_nonunit χ.val hr

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.ray_card_pos
statement: theorem ray_card_pos (H : Subgroup Rˣ) : 0 < Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H)
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_pos

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_characters
statement:
theorem average_characters (H : Subgroup Rˣ) (r : R) :
    (∑ χ : characters H, (χ : MulChar R ℂ) r) / (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) =
      if inUnitSubgroup H r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_characters]
  have hn : (Nat.card (Rˣ ⧸ H) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ray_card_pos H).ne'
  split_ifs <;> simp [hn]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.mem_rayCharacters_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rayCharacters_iff (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) :
    χ ∈ rayCharacters M ↔ IdealCharacter.UnitInvariant M χ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_characters_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h u
    exact h _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
  · intro h u hu
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hu
    exact h v

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff
statement:
theorem inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff (r : A ⧸ M) :
    inUnitSubgroup (globalUnits M) r ↔ principalResidue M r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hur, v, hv⟩
    exact ⟨v, (congrArg Units.val hv).trans hur⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    exact ⟨Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M).toMonoidHom u, hu, ⟨u, rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.rayCard_pos
statement: theorem rayCard_pos : 0 < rayCard M
proof: := ray_card_pos _

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_rayCharacters
statement:
theorem sum_rayCharacters (r : A ⧸ M) :
    ∑ χ : rayCharacters M, (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) r =
      if principalResidue M r then (rayCard M : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_characters, inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_rayCharacters
statement:
theorem average_rayCharacters (r : A ⧸ M) :
    (∑ χ : rayCharacters M, (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) r) / (rayCard M : ℂ) =
      if principalResidue M r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [average_characters, inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.principalIdeals_iff_generator
statement:
theorem principalIdeals_iff_generator {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    I ∈ principalIdeals M ↔
      principalResidue M (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, a, ha, u, hu⟩
    have hga : Associated (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I) a := by
      rw [← ha]
      exact Submodule.IsPrincipal.associated_generator_span_self a
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hga
    refine ⟨u * v⁻¹, ?_⟩
    have hq := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk M) hv
    simp only [map_mul] at hq
    simp only [Units.val_mul, map_mul]
    rw [hu, ← hq]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, map_one, mul_one]
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hI, _, Ideal.span_singleton_generator I, h⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.principalIdeals_iff_congruent_one
statement:
theorem principalIdeals_iff_congruent_one (I : Ideal A) :
    I ∈ principalIdeals M ↔ ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧
      Ideal.span ({a} : Set A) = I ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk M a = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hI, a, ha, u, hu⟩
    refine ⟨a * (u⁻¹ : Aˣ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply mul_ne_zero
      · exact fun h ↦ hI (ha ▸ (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr h))
      · exact Units.ne_zero _
    · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit (u⁻¹).isUnit, ha]
    · rw [map_mul, ← hu, ← map_mul, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel,
        Units.val_one, map_one]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hI, hq⟩
    refine ⟨?_, a, hI, 1, ?_⟩
    · exact fun h ↦ ha (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp (hI.trans h))
    · simpa only [Units.val_one, map_one] using hq.symm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.norm_idealCharacter_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_idealCharacter_le_one (χ : rayCharacters M) (I : Ideal A) :
    ‖idealCharacter M χ I‖ ≤ 1
proof: := IdealCharacter.norm_ofResidue_le_one M χ _ I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.idealCharacter_one
statement:
theorem idealCharacter_one (I : Ideal A) :
    idealCharacter M 1 I =
      if I = ⊥ then 0 else if IsCoprime I M then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  IdealCharacter.ofResidue_one M I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.sum_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem sum_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    ∑ χ : rayCharacters M, idealCharacter M χ I =
      if I ∈ principalIdeals M then (rayCard M : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · subst I
    simp [idealCharacter, principalIdeals]
  · have heq (χ : rayCharacters M) : idealCharacter M χ I =
        (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I)) := by
      exact IdealCharacter.ofResidue_of_generator M χ _ hI (Ideal.span_singleton_generator I)
    simp only [heq, sum_rayCharacters, principalIdeals_iff_generator M hI]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayOrthogonality.average_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem average_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    (∑ χ : rayCharacters M, idealCharacter M χ I) / (rayCard M : ℂ) =
      if I ∈ principalIdeals M then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_idealCharacters]
  have hn : (rayCard M : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (rayCard_pos M).ne'
  split_ifs <;> simp [hn]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CharacterTransport.pullback_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullback_apply (e : R ≃+* S) (χ : MulChar S ℂ) (x : R) :
    pullback e χ x = χ (e x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CharacterTransport.pullback_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullback_symm (e : R ≃+* S) (χ : MulChar S ℂ) :
    pullback e.symm (pullback e χ) = χ
proof:
:= by
  apply MulChar.ext'
  intro x
  simp

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CharacterTransport.pullback_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullback_mul (e : R ≃+* S) (χ ψ : MulChar S ℂ) :
    pullback e (χ * ψ) = pullback e χ * pullback e ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply MulChar.ext'
  intro x
  rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CharacterTransport.primitive_pullback
statement:
theorem primitive_pullback (e : R ≃+* S) (χ : MulChar S ℂ)
    (hχ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ) : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals (pullback e χ)
proof:
:= by
  intro I hI
  let J : Ideal S := I.comap e.symm.toRingHom
  have hJ : J ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hJ
    apply hI
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro x hx
    have he : e x ∈ J := by
      change e.symm (e x) ∈ I
      simpa using hx
    rw [hJ] at he
    have hx0 : x = 0 := e.injective (by simpa using he)
    exact hx0
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hχu⟩ := hχ J hJ
  let v : Rˣ := Units.map e.symm.toMonoidHom u
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change e.symm (u : S) - 1 ∈ I
    change e.symm ((u : S) - 1) ∈ I at hu
    simpa only [map_sub, map_one] using hu
  · simpa [v, pullback] using hχu

name: OAI.SevenEighths.CharacterTransport.primitive_pullback_iff
statement:
theorem primitive_pullback_iff (e : R ≃+* S) (χ : MulChar S ℂ) :
    IsPrimitiveOnIdeals (pullback e χ) ↔ IsPrimitiveOnIdeals χ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using primitive_pullback e.symm (pullback e χ) h
  · exact primitive_pullback e χ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_distinct_slot_lengths
statement:
theorem exists_distinct_slot_lengths (L : ℝ) (hL : 0<L) :
    ∃N : ℕ,0<N ∧ ∃ell : Fin N→ℝ,Function.Injective ell ∧
      (∀j,0<ell j ∧ ell j<L) ∧ (∑j,ell j)=1/6
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max 1 (1/(3*L)))
  have hN1 : (1:ℝ)<N := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hN
  have hNp : 0<(N:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hNnat : 0<N := by exact_mod_cast hNp
  have hNL : 1/(3*L)<(N:ℝ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hN
  have hsmall : 1/(3*(N:ℝ))<L := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (show 0<3*L by positivity)).mp hNL
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (show 0<3*(N:ℝ) by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith
  let w : Fin N→ℝ := fun j=>1+(j.val:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)
  let A : ℝ := ∑j,w j
  have hw (j : Fin N) : 1≤w j ∧ w j<2 := by
    have hj : (j.val:ℝ)<N := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
    have hdiv : (j.val:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)<1 := (div_lt_one hNp).mpr hj
    dsimp only [w]
    constructor
    · linarith [div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg j.val) hNp.le]
    · linarith
  have hA : (N:ℝ)≤A := by
    calc
      _ = ∑_j : Fin N,(1:ℝ) := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _=>(hw j).1
  have hAp : 0<A := hNp.trans_le hA
  let ell : Fin N→ℝ := fun j=>w j/(6*A)
  refine ⟨N,hNnat,ell,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro j k he
    have hden : 6*A≠0 := by positivity
    have hwjk : w j=w k := (div_left_inj' hden).mp he
    have hjk : (j.val:ℝ)/(N:ℝ)=(k.val:ℝ)/(N:ℝ) := by dsimp [w] at hwjk;linarith
    have he' : (j.val:ℝ)=(k.val:ℝ) := (div_left_inj' hNp.ne').mp hjk
    apply Fin.ext
    exact_mod_cast he'
  · intro j
    constructor
    · exact div_pos (by linarith [(hw j).1]) (by positivity)
    · calc
        ell j < 2/(6*A) := (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)).mpr (hw j).2
        _ ≤ 2/(6*(N:ℝ)) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ = 1/(3*(N:ℝ)) := by ring
        _ < L := hsmall
  · dsimp only [ell]
    rw [←Finset.sum_div]
    change A/(6*A)=1/6
    field_simp

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_physical_slot_lengths
statement:
theorem exists_physical_slot_lengths (dmin dmax mesh R : ℝ)
    (hdmin : 0<dmin) (hd : dmin≤dmax) (hm : 0<mesh) (hR : 0<R) :
    ∃N : ℕ,0<N ∧ ∃ell : Fin N→ℝ,∃rmin : ℝ,0<rmin ∧
      Function.Injective ell ∧ (∑j,ell j)=1/6 ∧
      (∀j,0<ell j ∧ dmax*rmin≤ell j ∧ ell j≤dmin*mesh ∧ ell j≤dmin*R) ∧
      (∀d : ℝ,dmin≤d → d≤dmax → ∀j,rmin≤ell j/d ∧ ell j/d≤mesh ∧ ell j/d≤R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,hN,ell,hi,he,hS⟩ := exists_distinct_slot_lengths (dmin*min mesh R)
    (mul_pos hdmin (lt_min hm hR))
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).Nonempty := ⟨⟨0,hN⟩,Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hjmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ ell hne
  have hmax : 0<dmax := hdmin.trans_le hd
  let rmin := ell j/(2*dmax)
  have hr : 0<rmin := div_pos (he j).1 (by positivity)
  have hlo (k : Fin N) : dmax*rmin≤ell k := by
    have hk := hjmin k (Finset.mem_univ k)
    have hiden : dmax*rmin=ell j/2 := by dsimp [rmin]; field_simp
    rw [hiden]
    linarith [(he j).1]
  have hup (k : Fin N) : ell k≤dmin*mesh ∧ ell k≤dmin*R := by
    constructor
    · exact (he k).2.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left _ _) hdmin.le)
    · exact (he k).2.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right _ _) hdmin.le)
  refine ⟨N,hN,ell,rmin,hr,hi,hS,fun k=>⟨(he k).1,hlo k,(hup k).1,(hup k).2⟩,?_⟩
  intro d hd' hd'' k
  have hd0 : 0<d := hdmin.trans_le hd'
  refine ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hd0).mpr ?_,(div_le_iff₀ hd0).mpr ?_,(div_le_iff₀ hd0).mpr ?_⟩
  · exact (by nlinarith : rmin*d≤dmax*rmin).trans (hlo k)
  · exact (hup k).1.trans (by nlinarith)
  · exact (hup k).2.trans (by nlinarith)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.classNumber_pos
statement: theorem classNumber_pos : 0 < classNumber M H
proof: := ray_card_pos H

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.character_unitInvariant
statement:
theorem character_unitInvariant (χ : Characters M H) :
    IdealCharacter.UnitInvariant M χ
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  exact (mem_characters_iff H χ).mp χ.property _ (hH ⟨u, rfl⟩)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.toFullRay_injective
statement: theorem toFullRay_injective : Function.Injective (toFullRay M H hH)
proof:
:= by
  intro χ ψ heq
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun ρ : rayCharacters M => (ρ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)) heq)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.toFullRay_eq_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFullRay_eq_one (χ : Characters M H) :
    toFullRay M H hH χ = 1 ↔ χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (toFullRay M H hH)]
  exact (toFullRay_injective M H hH).eq_iff

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.idealCharacter_eq_fullRay
statement:
theorem idealCharacter_eq_fullRay (χ : Characters M H) :
    idealCharacter M H hH χ = RayOrthogonality.idealCharacter M (toFullRay M H hH χ)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.identityClass_iff_generator
statement:
theorem identityClass_iff_generator {I : Ideal A} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    I ∈ identityClass M H ↔
      inUnitSubgroup H (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, a, ha, u, hua, huH⟩
    have hga : Associated (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I) a := by
      rw [← ha]
      exact Submodule.IsPrincipal.associated_generator_span_self a
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hga
    let w := Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M).toMonoidHom v
    refine ⟨u * w⁻¹, ?_, H.mul_mem huH (H.inv_mem (hH ⟨v, rfl⟩))⟩
    have hq := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk M) hv
    simp only [map_mul] at hq
    change (u : A ⧸ M) * ((Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M).toMonoidHom v)⁻¹ :
      (A ⧸ M)ˣ) = _
    rw [hua, ← hq]
    change (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I)) *
      (w : A ⧸ M) * (w⁻¹ : (A ⧸ M)ˣ) = _
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Units.val_one, mul_one]
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hI, _, Ideal.span_singleton_generator I, h⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.norm_idealCharacter_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_idealCharacter_le_one (χ : Characters M H) (I : Ideal A) :
    ‖idealCharacter M H hH χ I‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  IdealCharacter.norm_ofResidue_le_one M χ _ I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.idealCharacter_one
statement:
theorem idealCharacter_one (I : Ideal A) :
    idealCharacter M H hH 1 I =
      if I = ⊥ then 0 else if IsCoprime I M then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  IdealCharacter.ofResidue_one M I

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.sum_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem sum_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    ∑ χ : Characters M H, idealCharacter M H hH χ I =
      if I ∈ identityClass M H then (classNumber M H : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : I = ⊥
  · subst I
    simp [idealCharacter, identityClass]
  · have heq (χ : Characters M H) : idealCharacter M H hH χ I =
        (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I)) := by
      exact IdealCharacter.ofResidue_of_generator M χ _ hI (Ideal.span_singleton_generator I)
    simp only [heq, sum_characters, identityClass_iff_generator M H hH hI, classNumber]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.average_idealCharacters
statement:
theorem average_idealCharacters (I : Ideal A) :
    (∑ χ : Characters M H, idealCharacter M H hH χ I) / (classNumber M H : ℂ) =
      if I ∈ identityClass M H then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_idealCharacters]
  have hn : (classNumber M H : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (classNumber_pos M H).ne'
  split_ifs <;> simp [hn]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.RayQuotient.identityClass_globalUnits
statement: theorem identityClass_globalUnits : identityClass M (globalUnits M) = principalIdeals M
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  simp only [identityClass, principalIdeals, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    inUnitSubgroup_globalUnits_iff]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.rpow_isBigO_atTop_of_le
statement:
theorem rpow_isBigO_atTop_of_le {a b : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) :
    (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a) =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with x hx
  simpa only [one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ x) _)] using
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx h

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.common_signal_bound
statement:
theorem common_signal_bound (J f : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hJ : J =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ a))
    (herror : (fun x => J x - f x) =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ b)) :
    f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ max a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := hJ.trans (rpow_isBigO_atTop_of_le (le_max_left a b))
  have h₂ := herror.trans (rpow_isBigO_atTop_of_le (le_max_right a b))
  simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using h₁.sub h₂

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.common_signal_bound_with_margin
statement:
theorem common_signal_bound_with_margin (J f : ℝ → ℂ) (β ω σ c : ℝ)
    (hJ : J =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (7 / 8 + c + ω)))
    (herror : (fun x => J x - f x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (β + c - σ))) :
    f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ =>
      x ^ (β + c - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Supremum.max_signal_exponents] using
    common_signal_bound J f (7 / 8 + c + ω) (β + c - σ) hJ herror

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.signalMellin_convergent
statement:
theorem signalMellin_convergent (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (a + c)))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f) {s : ℂ} (hs : a < s.re) :
    MellinConvergent f (-(s + (c : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply mellinConvergent_of_isBigO_rpow (a := -(a+c))
    (b := (-(s + (c : ℂ))).re - 1) hlocal
  · simpa only [neg_neg] using htop
  · simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
    linarith
  · exact hzero _
  · linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.signalMellin_analytic
statement:
theorem signalMellin_analytic (f : ℝ → ℂ) (a c : ℝ)
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (a + c)))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (signalMellin f c) {s : ℂ | a < s.re}
proof:
:= by
  apply (Complex.analyticOnNhd_iff_differentiableOn (Complex.isOpen_re_gt a)).2
  intro s hs
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℂ (mellin f) (-(s + (c : ℂ))) := by
    apply mellin_differentiableAt_of_isBigO_rpow (a := -(a+c))
      (b := (-(s + (c : ℂ))).re - 1) hlocal
    · simpa only [neg_neg] using htop
    · simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
      change a < s.re at hs
      linarith
    · exact hzero _
    · linarith
  exact (hd.comp s ((differentiableAt_id.add_const (c : ℂ)).neg)).differentiableWithinAt

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.product_identity_on_halfPlane
statement:
theorem product_identity_on_halfPlane (a b : ℝ) (L M W : ℂ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ L {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hM : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ M {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, max a b < s.re → L s * M s = W s) :
    Set.EqOn (fun s => L s * M s) W {s : ℂ | a < s.re}
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := (max a b + 1 : ℝ)
  have hz : a < z.re := by dsimp [z]; linarith [le_max_left a b]
  have hz' : max a b < z.re := by dsimp [z]; simp
  have hev : (fun s => L s * M s) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] W := by
    filter_upwards [(Complex.isOpen_re_gt (max a b)).mem_nhds hz'] with s hs
    exact heq s hs
  exact (hL.mul hM).eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hW
    (convex_halfSpace_re_gt a).isPreconnected hz hev

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.nonzero_of_regularized_signal
statement:
theorem nonzero_of_regularized_signal (a b c : ℝ)
    (L Lregular R W : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Lregular {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ R {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hW : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ W {s : ℂ | a < s.re})
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (htop : f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (a + c)))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f)
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, max a b < s.re →
      Lregular s * signalMellin f c s = R s * W s)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : a < ρ.re)
    (hregular : Lregular ρ = R ρ * L ρ)
    (hRρ : R ρ ≠ 0) (hWρ : W ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hid := product_identity_on_halfPlane a b Lregular (signalMellin f c)
    (fun s => R s * W s) hL (signalMellin_analytic f a c hlocal htop hzero)
    (hR.mul hW) heq hρ
  intro hz
  change Lregular ρ * signalMellin f c ρ = R ρ * W ρ at hid
  rw [hregular, hz, mul_zero, zero_mul] at hid
  exact (mul_ne_zero hRρ hWρ) hid.symm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.multiplier_ne_zero
statement:
theorem multiplier_ne_zero {H : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (h : ‖H s - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) : H s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  simp [hz] at h
  norm_num at h

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.gaussianMultiplier_analytic
statement:
theorem gaussianMultiplier_analytic {H : ℂ → ℂ} {U : Set ℂ}
    (hH : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H U) : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (gaussianMultiplier H) U
proof:
:= by
  exact ((analyticOnNhd_id.sub analyticOnNhd_const).pow 2).cexp.mul hH

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.gaussianMultiplier_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gaussianMultiplier_ne_zero {H : ℂ → ℂ} {s : ℂ}
    (hH : ‖H s - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) : gaussianMultiplier H s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero (Complex.exp_ne_zero _) (multiplier_ne_zero hH)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.nonzero_of_common_signal
statement:
theorem nonzero_of_common_signal (β ω σ c : ℝ) (hω : 0 < ω)
    (L Lregular R H : ℂ → ℂ) (J f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hL : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ Lregular
      {s : ℂ | β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < s.re})
    (hR : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ R
      {s : ℂ | β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < s.re})
    (hH : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H {s : ℂ | 7 / 8 < s.re})
    (hcontract : ∀ s : ℂ, 7 / 8 < s.re → ‖H s - 1‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hlocal : LocallyIntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hzero : RapidDecayAtZero f)
    (hJ : J =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (7 / 8 + c + ω)))
    (herror : (fun x => J x - f x) =O[atTop]
      (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (β + c - σ)))
    (heq : ∀ s : ℂ, max (β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ) 1 < s.re →
      Lregular s * signalMellin f c s = R s * gaussianMultiplier H s)
    {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < ρ.re)
    (hregular : Lregular ρ = R ρ * L ρ) (hRρ : R ρ ≠ 0) : L ρ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hboundary := Supremum.continuation_boundary_gt (β := β) (σ := σ) hω
  have hH' : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H
      {s : ℂ | β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ < s.re} :=
    hH.mono (fun s hs => lt_trans hboundary hs)
  have htop : f =O[atTop] (fun x : ℝ =>
      x ^ ((β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ) + c)) := by
    have hexp : (β - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ) + c =
        β + c - Supremum.continuationMargin β ω σ := by ring
    simpa only [hexp] using common_signal_bound_with_margin J f β ω σ c hJ herror
  exact nonzero_of_regularized_signal _ 1 c L Lregular R (gaussianMultiplier H) f
    hL hR (gaussianMultiplier_analytic hH') hlocal htop hzero heq hρ hregular
    hRρ (gaussianMultiplier_ne_zero (hcontract ρ (lt_trans hboundary hρ)))

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteConductor.FactorsThroughIdeal.bot
statement: theorem FactorsThroughIdeal.bot (χ : MulChar R ℂ) : FactorsThroughIdeal χ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorsThroughIdeal_iff]
  intro u hu
  have hu1 : (u : R) = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp hu
  rw [hu1, map_one]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.FiniteConductor.FactorsThroughIdeal.pow
statement:
theorem FactorsThroughIdeal.pow {χ : MulChar R ℂ} {I : Ideal R}
    (hχ : FactorsThroughIdeal χ I) (n : ℕ) : FactorsThroughIdeal (χ ^ n) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorsThroughIdeal_iff] at hχ ⊢
  intro u hu
  rw [MulChar.pow_apply_coe, hχ u hu, one_pow]

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.quotientCharacter_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientCharacter_mk (M : Ideal A) (I : Ideal (A ⧸ M))
    (φ : MulChar ((A ⧸ M) ⧸ I) ℂ) (a : A) :
    quotientCharacter M I φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) =
      φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.primitive_quotientCharacter
statement:
theorem primitive_quotientCharacter (M : Ideal A) (I : Ideal (A ⧸ M))
    (φ : MulChar ((A ⧸ M) ⧸ I) ℂ) (hφ : IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ) :
    IsPrimitiveOnIdeals (quotientCharacter M I φ)
proof:
:=
  CharacterTransport.primitive_pullback _ _ hφ

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.source_le_comap
statement:
theorem source_le_comap (M : Ideal A) (I : Ideal (A ⧸ M)) :
    M ≤ I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk M a ∈ I
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha]
  exact I.zero_mem

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.unit_factorization_of_mask
statement:
theorem unit_factorization_of_mask (M K : Ideal A) (hMK : M ≤ K)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ)
    (hmask : ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
      if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0) :
    φ.toUnitHom.comp (Units.map (Ideal.Quotient.factor hMK).toMonoidHom) =
      χ.toUnitHom
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro u
  apply Units.ext
  change φ (Ideal.Quotient.factor hMK (u : A ⧸ M)) = χ (u : A ⧸ M)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (u : A ⧸ M)
  have h := hmask a
  simp only [ha, u.isUnit, ite_true] at h
  simpa only [← ha, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk] using h.symm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.comap_ne_bot
statement:
theorem comap_ne_bot (M : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)] (I : Ideal (A ⧸ M)) :
    I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite ((A ⧸ M) ⧸ I) :=
    Finite.of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := I))
  have hpos : 0 < (I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)).absNorm := by
    rw [absNorm_comap_eq_quotient_card]
    exact Nat.card_pos
  intro hzero
  rw [hzero, Ideal.absNorm_bot] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.exists_primitive_presentation_above_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_presentation_above_quotient
    (M : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)] (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (J : Ideal (A ⧸ M)) (hJ : FactorsThroughIdeal χ J) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal A) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ),
      M ≤ K ∧ J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M) ≤ K ∧ K ≠ ⊥ ∧
      IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ K.absNorm ≤ (J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)).absNorm ∧
      ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
        if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, ψ, hJI, hψ, hprimitive, hmaximal, hnorm, hmask⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_residue_quotient_above_with_norm_and_mask M χ J hJ
  refine ⟨I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M), quotientCharacter M I ψ,
    source_le_comap M I, Ideal.comap_mono hJI, comap_ne_bot M I,
    primitive_quotientCharacter M I ψ hprimitive, hnorm, ?_⟩
  intro a
  simpa only [quotientCharacter_mk] using hmask (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.exists_primitive_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_presentation (M : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)]
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal A) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ),
      M ≤ K ∧ K ≠ ⊥ ∧ IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ K.absNorm ≤ M.absNorm ∧
      ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
        if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, φ, hMK, hbotK, hK, hprimitive, hnorm, hmask⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_presentation_above_quotient M χ ⊥ (FactorsThroughIdeal.bot χ)
  refine ⟨K, φ, hMK, hK, hprimitive, ?_, hmask⟩
  simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker] using hnorm

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.exists_primitive_presentation_above
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_presentation_above
    (M L : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)] (hML : M ≤ L)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (hL : FactorsThroughIdeal χ (L.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M))) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal A) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ),
      M ≤ K ∧ L ≤ K ∧ K ≠ ⊥ ∧ IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ K.absNorm ≤ L.absNorm ∧
      ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
        if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Ideal.comap_map_mk hML] using
    exists_primitive_presentation_above_quotient M χ (L.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)) hL

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.exists_primitive_product_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_product_presentation
    (M L₁ L₂ : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)] (hML₁ : M ≤ L₁) (hML₂ : M ≤ L₂)
    (χ ψ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (hχ : FactorsThroughIdeal χ (L₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)))
    (hψ : FactorsThroughIdeal ψ (L₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M))) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal A) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ),
      M ≤ K ∧ L₁ ⊓ L₂ ≤ K ∧ K ≠ ⊥ ∧ IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧
      K.absNorm ≤ L₁.absNorm * L₂.absNorm ∧
      ∀ a : A, χ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) * ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
        if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, φ, hJI, hφ, hprimitive, hmaximal, hnorm, hmask⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_residue_product_with_norm_and_mask M χ ψ
      (L₁.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)) (L₂.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M)) hχ hψ
  refine ⟨I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk M), quotientCharacter M I φ,
    source_le_comap M I, ?_, comap_ne_bot M I,
    primitive_quotientCharacter M I φ hprimitive, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := Ideal.comap_mono (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk M) hJI
    simpa only [Ideal.comap_inf, Ideal.comap_map_mk hML₁, Ideal.comap_map_mk hML₂] using h
  · simpa only [Ideal.comap_map_mk hML₁, Ideal.comap_map_mk hML₂] using hnorm
  · intro a
    simpa only [quotientCharacter_mk] using hmask (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.ConductorPresentation.exists_primitive_power_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_power_presentation
    (M L : Ideal A) [Finite (A ⧸ M)] (hML : M ≤ L)
    (χ : MulChar (A ⧸ M) ℂ)
    (hχ : FactorsThroughIdeal χ (L.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk M))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (K : Ideal A) (φ : MulChar (A ⧸ K) ℂ),
      M ≤ K ∧ L ≤ K ∧ K ≠ ⊥ ∧ IsPrimitiveOnIdeals φ ∧ K.absNorm ≤ L.absNorm ∧
      ∀ a : A, (χ ^ n) (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) =
        if IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk M a) then φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk K a) else 0
proof:
:=
  exists_primitive_presentation_above M L hML (χ ^ n) (hχ.pow n)

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_small_increment
statement:
theorem exists_small_increment (M : ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {lo hi e : ℝ} (hlo : lo ≤ M 0) (hhi : M n ≤ hi)
    (hwidth : hi - lo ≤ n * e) :
    ∃ i < n, M (i + 1) - M i ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hinc : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, e < M (i + 1) - M i := by
    intro i hi
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => h ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mp hi, hle⟩)
  have hs := Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty (Finset.nonempty_range_iff.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)) hinc
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
    Finset.sum_range_sub] at hs
  linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.buffered_bin_of_rounding
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hround.1, hround.2, by linarith [hround.2]⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_grid_rounding
statement:
theorem exists_grid_rounding {base x e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e) (hx : base ≤ x) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, base + e * k ≤ x ∧ x < base + e * k + e
proof:
:= by
  let k := ⌊(x - base) / e⌋₊
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (x - base) / e := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx) he.le
  have hlo := Nat.floor_le hnonneg
  have hhi := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((x - base) / e)
  have hlo' := (le_div_iff₀ he).mp hlo
  have hhi' := (div_lt_iff₀ he).mp hhi
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> dsimp [k] <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.exists_buffered_bin
statement:
theorem exists_buffered_bin (M : ℕ → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {e : ℝ} (he : 0 < e)
    (hbound : ∀ j ≤ n, (51 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ M j ∧ M j ≤ 1)
    (hwidth : (49 / 100 : ℝ) ≤ n * e) :
    ∃ i < n, ∃ k : ℕ,
      let a : ℝ := 51 / 100 + e * k
      a ≤ 1 ∧ a ≤ M i ∧ M i < a + e ∧ M (i + 1) < a + 2 * e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hstep⟩ := exists_small_increment M hn (e := e)
    (hbound 0 (Nat.zero_le _)).1 (hbound n le_rfl).2 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨k, hklo, hkhi⟩ := exists_grid_rounding he (hbound i hi.le).1
  refine ⟨i, hi, k, ?_, hklo, hkhi, ?_⟩
  · exact hklo.trans (hbound i hi.le).2
  · linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.maximal_zero_of_floor_lt
statement:
theorem maximal_zero_of_floor_lt {ι : Type*} (L : ι → ℂ → ℂ)
    (zeros : Finset (ι × ℂ)) {floor M : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ p ∈ zeros, L p.1 p.2 = 0)
    (hmax : M ∈ insert floor (zeros.image (fun p => p.2.re)))
    (hfloor : floor < M) :
    ∃ χ ρ, (χ, ρ) ∈ zeros ∧ L χ ρ = 0 ∧ ρ.re = M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hmax with h | h
  · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hfloor) h)
  · obtain ⟨⟨χ, ρ⟩, hp, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h
    exact ⟨χ, ρ, hp, hzero _ hp, heq⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.simultaneous_saturation
statement:
theorem simultaneous_saturation {U δ r m ε A B : ℝ}
    (hU : 1 < U) (hδ : (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hprod : U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) ≤ A * B)
    (hupperA : A ≤ U ^ (δ * r + ε))
    (hupperB : B ≤ U ^ (δ * min m (1 - m) + ε)) :
    m ≤ 1 / 2 + 75 * ε ∧
      U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) ≤ A ∧ U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hU0 : 0 < U := by linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by linarith
  have hBcoarse : B ≤ U ^ (δ * m + ε) := by
    apply hupperB.trans
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hU.le
      (by have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left m (1 - m)) hδ0; linarith)
  have hpupper : A * B ≤ U ^ (δ * r + ε + (δ * min m (1 - m) + ε)) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add hU0]
    exact mul_le_mul hupperA hupperB hB (Real.rpow_nonneg hU0.le _)
  have hexp := (Real.rpow_le_rpow_left_iff hU).mp (hprod.trans hpupper)
  have hlength : m ≤ 1 / 2 + 75 * ε := by
    by_cases hm : m ≤ 1 / 2
    · linarith
    · have hmin : min m (1 - m) = 1 - m := min_eq_right (by linarith)
      rw [hmin] at hexp
      have hm0 : 0 ≤ m - 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ hm0
      nlinarith
  have hlowerA : U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) ≤ A := by
    have hp : U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) * U ^ (δ * m + ε) ≤
        A * U ^ (δ * m + ε) := by
      calc
        _ = U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hU0]; congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ A * B := hprod
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBcoarse hA
    have hpos := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hU0 (δ * m + ε)
    nlinarith
  have hlowerB : U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) ≤ B := by
    have hp : U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) * U ^ (δ * r + ε) ≤
        B * U ^ (δ * r + ε) := by
      calc
        _ = U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hU0]; congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ A * B := hprod
        _ ≤ _ := by simpa [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hupperA hB
    have hpos := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hU0 (δ * r + ε)
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨hlength, hlowerA, hlowerB⟩

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.inverse_length_of_saturation
proof: := by linarith

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Detector.complex_simultaneous_saturation
statement:
theorem complex_simultaneous_saturation {U δ r m ε : ℝ} {M S : ℂ}
    (hU : 1 < U) (hδ : (1 / 50 : ℝ) ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hprod : U ^ (δ * (r + m) - ε) ≤ ‖M * S‖ ^ 2)
    (hupperM : ‖M‖ ^ 2 ≤ U ^ (δ * r + ε))
    (hupperS : ‖S‖ ^ 2 ≤ U ^ (δ * min m (1 - m) + ε)) :
    m ≤ 1 / 2 + 75 * ε ∧
      U ^ (δ * r - 2 * ε) ≤ ‖M‖ ^ 2 ∧
      U ^ (δ * m - 2 * ε) ≤ ‖S‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply simultaneous_saturation hU hδ hε (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
    _ hupperM hupperS
  simpa only [norm_mul, mul_pow] using hprod

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.fixed_bad_primes_prime
statement: lemma fixed_bad_primes_prime : ∀ P∈fixedBadPrimes,Prime P
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hP with hP|hP
  · subst P
    exact Ideal.prime_of_isPrime
      (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr PrimaryIdealUnitReindex.lambda_prime_actual.ne_zero)
      lambdaIdeal_maximal.isPrime
  · have he := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hP
    subst P
    exact Ideal.prime_of_isPrime
      (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr (by norm_num : (2:O)≠0))
      twoIdeal_maximal.isPrime

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_fixed_source
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_source (e : ℝ) (he : 0<e)
    (S₀ : Finset (Ideal O)) (hS₀ : ∀P∈S₀,Prime P) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Ideal O), S₀⊆S ∧ SourceExclusions S ∧
      FirstTail (4*e) S ∧ (∀P∈S,P.IsMaximal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hsub,hS,hfirst⟩ := exists_both_source_exclusions (4*e) (by positivity)
    (S₀∪fixedBadPrimes)
    (fun P hP => (Finset.mem_union.mp hP).elim (hS₀ P) (fixed_bad_primes_prime P))
    Finset.subset_union_right
  refine ⟨S,Finset.subset_union_left.trans hsub,hS,hfirst,?_⟩
  intro P hP
  exact (Ideal.isPrime_of_prime (hS.prime P hP)).isMaximal (hS.prime P hP).ne_zero

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Parameters.exists_fixed_probe_window
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_probe_window : ∃ (w : ℝ→ℝ) (W : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ),
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w ∧
    Function.support w⊆Set.Ioo 1 2 ∧ tsupport w⊆Set.Ioi 0 ∧
    (∀x,0≤w x ∧ w x≤1) ∧ w≠0 ∧ (∀x,W x=(w x:ℂ)) ∧ W≠0 ∧
    Function.support W⊆Set.Icc 1 2 ∧
    (∀x,(W x).im=0) ∧ (∀x,0≤(W x).re)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w,W,hw,hc,hs,hb,hv,hn,he,hWn,hWs,hr,hp⟩ := exists_probe_window
  refine ⟨w,W,hw,hc,hs,?_,hb,hn,he,hWn,hWs,hr,hp⟩
  have hcl : tsupport w⊆Set.Icc 1 2 :=
    closure_minimal (hs.trans Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self) isClosed_Icc
  intro x hx
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (hcl hx).1

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.integrable_logProfile
proof:
:= by
  have hder : ∀ x ∈ (univ : Set ℝ),
      HasDerivWithinAt (Real.exp ∘ Neg.neg) (-Real.exp (-x)) univ x :=
    fun x _ => mul_neg_one (Real.exp (-x)) ▸
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_neg x)).hasDerivWithinAt
  have himage : Real.exp ∘ Neg.neg '' (univ : Set ℝ) = Ioi 0 := by
    rw [Set.image_comp, Set.image_univ_of_surjective neg_surjective,
      Set.image_univ, Real.range_exp]
  have hinj : univ.InjOn (Real.exp ∘ Neg.neg) :=
    Real.exp_injective.injOn.comp neg_injective.injOn (univ.mapsTo_univ _)
  rw [MellinConvergent, ← himage,
    integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_deriv_smul MeasurableSet.univ hder hinj] at hf
  have heq (u : ℝ) :
      |-(Real.exp (-u))| • ((Real.exp (-u) : ℂ) ^ ((σ : ℂ) - 1) • f (Real.exp (-u))) =
        Real.exp (-σ * u) • f (Real.exp (-u)) := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    change (Real.exp (-u) : ℂ) *
      ((Real.exp (-u) : ℂ) ^ ((σ : ℂ) - 1) * f (Real.exp (-u))) =
        (Real.exp (-σ * u) : ℂ) * f (Real.exp (-u))
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [show (σ : ℂ) - 1 = ((σ - 1 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; rfl,
      ← Complex.ofReal_cpow (Real.exp_pos (-u)).le]
    norm_cast
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos (-u)), Real.log_exp, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, integrableOn_univ, heq] using hf

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.mellin_mellinInv_eq
statement:
theorem mellin_mellinInv_eq (σ : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hf : MellinConvergent f (σ : ℂ))
    (hF : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
    (hcont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
    (hrep : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x = mellinInv σ F x) (y : ℝ) :
    mellin f ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I) =
      F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => F ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => Real.exp (-σ * u) • f (Real.exp (-u))
  have hg : Integrable g := integrable_logProfile hf
  have hginv : g = 𝓕⁻ A := by
    funext u
    dsimp [g]
    rw [hrep _ (Real.exp_pos _), mellinInv_eq_fourierInv _ _ (Real.exp_pos _)]
    simp only [Real.log_exp, neg_neg]
    change (Real.exp (-σ * u) : ℂ) *
      ((Real.exp (-u) : ℂ) ^ (-(σ : ℂ)) * 𝓕⁻ A u) = 𝓕⁻ A u
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_neg,
      ← Complex.ofReal_cpow (Real.exp_pos (-u)).le]
    have hc : Real.exp (-σ * u) * Real.exp (-u) ^ (-σ) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (Real.exp_pos (-u)), Real.log_exp, ← Real.exp_add]
      rw [show -σ * u + -u * -σ = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_mul, hc, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  have hfourier : Integrable (𝓕 A) := by
    have hn := hg.comp_neg
    rw [hginv] at hn
    simpa only [Real.fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg, neg_neg] using hn
  rw [mellin_eq_fourier]
  have hre : ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I).re = σ := by simp
  have him : ((σ : ℂ) + 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I).im / (2 * Real.pi) = y := by
    simp
  rw [hre, him]
  change 𝓕 g y = A y
  rw [hginv]
  exact hF.fourier_fourierInv_eq hfourier hcont.continuousAt

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.mellin_normalizedSignal
statement:
theorem mellin_normalizedSignal (f : ℝ → ℂ) (c : ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    mellin (normalizedSignal f c) (-s) = signalMellin f c s
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedSignal signalMellin
  rw [mellin_cpow_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.SevenEighths.Continuation.signalMellin_eq_on_line
statement:
theorem signalMellin_eq_on_line (f : ℝ → ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ) (c d : ℝ)
    (hf : MellinConvergent f (-((d : ℂ) + (c : ℂ))))
    (hA : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => A ((d : ℂ) - 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
    (hcont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => A ((d : ℂ) - 2 * Real.pi * y * Complex.I)))
